name: Luster Dragon
description:
A very beautiful
dragon covered with
sapphire. It does
not like fights, but
has incredibly high
attack power.

name: X-Head Cannon
description:
A monster with a
mighty cannon
barrel, it is able
to integrate its
attacks.

name: Gazelle the King of Mythical Beasts
description:
This monster moves
so fast that it
looks like an
illusion to mortal
eyes. (This card is
always treated as a
"Phantom Beast"
card.)

name: Archfiend Soldier
description:
An expert at battle
who belongs to a
crack diabolical
unit. He's famous
because he always
gets the job done.

name: Mystical Shine Ball
description:
A soul of light
covered by mystical
shine. When you see
its beautiful shape,
your dream will come
true.

name: Hyozanryu
description:
A dragon created
from a massive
diamond that
sparkles with
blinding light.

name: Dark Blade
description:
They say he is a
dragon-manipulating
warrior from the
dark world. His
attack is
tremendous, using
his great swords
with vicious power.

name: Gagagigo
description:
This young evildoer
used to have an evil
heart, but by
meeting a special
person, he
discovered justice.

name: Thousand-Eyes Idol
description:
A wicked entity that
controls the hearts
of men, its thousand
eyes are able to see
and expand the
negative influences
in an individual's
soul.

name: Alpha The Magnet Warrior
description:
Alpha, Beta, and
Gamma meld as one to
form a powerful
monster.

name: Gogiga Gagagigo
description:
His soul long-since
collapsed, his body
recklessly continues
onward, driven by a
lust for more power.
He no longer
resembles his former
self....

name: Ryu-Ran
description:
A vicious little
dragon sheltered in
an egg that looks
deceptively
harmless.

name: Beta The Magnet Warrior
description:
Alpha, Beta, and
Gamma meld as one to
form a powerful
monster.

name: Gamma the Magnet Warrior
description:
Alpha, Beta, and
Gamma meld as one to
form a powerful
monster.

name: Humanoid Slime
description:
This slime
apparently has some
human genes in its
genetic makeup.

name: Ojama Black
description:
He's one of the
Ojama Trio. It's
said that he butts
in by any means
necessary. It's also
said that when the
three are together,
something happens.

name: Ojama Green
description:
He's one of the
Ojama Trio. It's
said that he butts
in by any means
necessary. It's also
said that when the
three are together,
something happens.

name: Mad Dog of Darkness
description:
He used to be a
normal dog who
played around in a
park, but was
corrupted by the
powers of darkness.

name: Wingweaver
description:
A six-winged fairy
who prays for peace
and hope.

name: Earthbound Spirit
description:
A vengeful creature
formed by the
spirits of fallen
warriors, it drags
any who dare
approach it into the
deepest bowels of
the earth.

name: Amphibian Beast
description:
On land or in the
sea, the speed of
this monster is
unmatchable.

name: Ojama Yellow
description:
He's one of the
Ojama Trio. It's
said that he butts
in by any means
necessary. It's also
said that when the
three are together,
something happens.

name: Melchid the Four-Face Beast
description:
This monster has
four different masks
for four different
attacks.

name: Sky Scout
description:
With eyes like a
hawk and a flying
speed exceeding Mach
5, this monster is a
master of the sky.

name: Slot Machine
description:
The machine's
ability is said to
vary according to
its slot results.

name: Headless Knight
description:
A haunted spirit of
a falsely accused
knight who wanders
in search of truth
and justice.

name: Twin-Headed Fire Dragon
description:
Two dragons fused as
one from the effects
of the Big Bang.

name: The Gross Ghost of Fled Dreams
description:
This monster feeds
on the dreams of an
unwary sleeper,
dragging the victim
into eternal
slumber.

name: Grand Tiki Elder
description:
A masked monster
that wields the most
deadly of curses.

name: The Earl of Demise
description:
This gentlemanly
creature is
extremely wicked,
feared by man and
fiend alike.

name: Shining Abyss
description:
This monster employs
the powers of both
Light and Darkness.

name: Red Archery Girl
description:
A mermaid archer
that hides in a
protective shell,
waiting for the
right moment to
strike.

name: Swordsman of Landstar
description:
An amateur with a
sword, this fairy
warrior relies on
its mysterious
powers.

name: Flying Kamakiri #2
description:
A flying mantis that
feeds primarily on
insects.

name: Worm Drake
description:
Once this monster
wraps itself around
a victim, there is
no escape.

name: Luster Dragon #2
description:
This dragon feeds on
emerald. Enchanted
by this monster even
when attacked, few
people live to tell
of its beauty.

name: Giga Gagagigo
description:
In order to fight
tremendous evil, he
gained formidable
power through body
reconstruction, but
lost his heart and
his redemption.

name: Gadget Soldier
description:
A rust-free machine
warrior born to
battle.

name: Opticlops
description:
A one-eyed giant
that serves the
"Dark Ruler Ha Des",
it skewers its
enemies with its
sharp horn,
shattering them to
pieces.

name: The Portrait's Secret
description:
A portrait cursed by
the artist, it is
said to bring ill
fortune to anyone
who owns it.

name: Great Angus
description:
A very violent
beast, it is always
berserk. People say
that they have never
seen it silent.

name: Darkfire Soldier #1
description:
An explosive expert
from a special elite
force.

name: Gradius
description:
A high-performance
jet fighter with
power capsules for
variable attack
capabilities.

name: Warrior Dai Grepher
description:
The warrior who can
manipulate dragons.
Nobody knows his
mysterious past.

name: Girochin Kuwagata
description:
Despite its small
size, this monster
has powerful jaws
that can rip metal
to shreds.

name: Souls of the Forgotten
description:
A wicked spirit
created by the
hateful souls of
those who fell in
battle. It grows by
assimilating the
souls of its
enemies.

name: Island Turtle
description:
A huge turtle that
is often mistaken
for an island.

name: The Dragon Dwelling in the Cave
description:
A huge dragon
dwelling in a cave.
It is horrible when
it gets angry,
although it is
usually quiet. It is
said to preserve
certain treasures.

name: Three-Headed Geedo
description:
A three-headed
nocturnal monster
that is absolutely
ruthless when
fighting.

name: Overdrive
description:
An all-terrain
armored vehicle
armed with a heavy-
duty machine gun.

name: Darkfire Soldier #2
description:
A warrior who gained
immeasurable power
from the heart of a
volcano.

name: Mokey Mokey
description:
An outcast angel.
Nobody knows what he
is thinking at all.
Sometimes he gets
mad and that is
dreadful.

name: Kabazauls
description:
A huge monster in
the shape of a
hippopotamus. The
sneezing from his
gigantic body is so
fierce that people
mistake it for a
hurricane.

name: Garnecia Elefantis
description:
A monster so heavy
that each step rocks
the earth.

name: Charcoal Inpachi
description:
A wicked wooden
spirit that has
burned out. The
barbecue grilled
with this charcoal
is so awesome that
everybody thinks
it's priceless.

name: Big Koala
description:
A species of huge
Des Koala. He's
meek, but people are
afraid of him
because he's very
powerful.

name: Skull Mariner
description:
A pirate ship that
appears out of the
mist and sinks any
seagoing vessels.

name: Terrorking Salmon
description:
A feared salmon,
master of the Sea of
Darkness. Its roe is
the best delicacy in
the World of
Darkness.

name: Blazing Inpachi
description:
A wicked wooden
spirit now burning
in flames. Its fire
attack is powerful,
but it will soon be
nothing but ashes.

name: Spikebot
description:
A mechanical soldier
created by a wicked
sorcerer, it attacks
with the two steel
balls attached to
its arms.

name: Mr. Volcano
description:
This seemingly mild-
mannered creature
has an extremely
volatile temper.

name: Metal Armored Bug
description:
A gigantic insect-
like creature
covered by thick
armor. Everything in
his path is
destroyed.

name: Robotic Knight
description:
The Commander of
Machine-Types, he
serves the Machine
King. He is famous
for the way he
controls his troops.

name: Oni Tank T-34
description:
An armored tank
possessed by a fiend
that will pursue
enemies until
they're crushed.

name: Steel Ogre Grotto #2
description:
A mechanized iron
doll with tremendous
strength.

name: Neo Bug
description:
A huge bug-like
monster said to come
from another planet.
It gathers in
swarms.

name: Flying Fish
description:
Three wishes are
granted to those
fortunate enough to
see this monster in
flight.

name: Neo the Magic Swordsman
description:
A dimensional
drifter who not only
practices sorcery,
but is also a sword
and martial arts
master.

name: Sea Serpent Warrior of Darkness
description:
A warrior who
defends the world of
the Sea of Darkness.
He prides himself on
his fighting prowess
both on the ground
and, of course, in
the water.

name: Cyber Falcon
description:
A jet-powered hawk
that travels at the
speed of sound.

name: Master Kyonshee
description:
A wandering Kyonshee
searching for a
strong rival to
defeat. They say he
was known as the
master of all
martial arts.

name: Oppressed People
description:
They are oppressed,
but believe they
will have their
freedom someday.

name: Flame Champion
description:
A warrior protected
by a flaming shield
that nullifies any
attack.

name: Empress Mantis
description:
Queen of an army of
giant mantises whose
command moves
legions.

name: Aitsu
description:
He seems to be very
unreliable, but he
might have
incredible
potential.

name: Beast of Talwar
description:
Only the master of
the sword among
Fiend-Type monsters
is permitted to hold
the Talwar. (This
card is always
treated as an
"Archfiend" card.)

name: D.D. Trainer
description:
A poor goblin that
was sucked into a
different dimension.
However, he's doing
his best with his
new destiny.

name: Dokuroyaiba
description:
A boomerang with
brains that will
pursue a target to
the ends of the
earth.

name: Inpachi
description:
A log that attacks
lost travelers in
the forest.
Originally a big
tree, it was cut
down and possessed
by a wicked spirit.

name: Harpie Girl
description:
A Harpie chick who
aspires to flit
about beautifully
and gorgeously, but
attack sharply.

name: Battle Footballer
description:
A cyborg with high
defense power.
Originally it was
invented for a
football machine.

name: The All-Seeing White Tiger
description:
A proud ruler of the
jungle that some
fear and others
respect.

name: The Illusory Gentleman
description:
Wearing odd
fashions, this
gentleman is very
fickle. He sometimes
saves people and at
other times commits
crimes.

name: Neo Aqua Madoor
description:
The true nature of
this wizard, who
rules all water. It
defends itself with
a vast, impenetrable
wall of ice.

name: Soul Tiger
description:
The soul of a tiger
that is said to
devour human souls.
He is a famous soul
that you wouldn't
want to run into in
a dark alley.

name: Wolf Axwielder
description:
Once it has started
battle, this monster
attacks fiercely and
cannot stop.

name: Bio-Mage
description:
A mysterious priest
created as a result
of the latest
advances in
biotechnology.

name: Robolady
description:
A warrior fully
covered with metal.
It upgrades by
fusing with
"Roboyarou".

name: Warrior of Zera
description:
A wandering warrior
who seeks the
sanctuary where he
can gain the power
of the Archlords.

name: Lizard Soldier
description:
A beast soldier
derived from
dragons, it is small
for a Dragon-Type.
Moving very quickly,
this monster is an
excellent
strategist.

name: Sonic Duck
description:
A duck which can
walk at a sonic
speed. Sometimes, he
cannot deal with his
incredible pace and
loses control.

name: Roboyarou
description:
A warrior fully
covered with metal.
It upgrades by
fusing with
"Robolady".

name: Science Soldier
description:
Soldiers equipped
with state-of-the-
art weaponry to face
unknown creatures.

name: Dark Bat
description:
Bats from the
netherworld that use
their hyper senses
to detect their
enemies.

name: Acrobat Monkey
description:
An autonomous monkey
type robot which was
developed with
cutting-edge
technology. It moves
very acrobatically.

name: Pharaoh's Servant
description:
An apparition of
those said to
formerly serve the
Pharaoh. It has
tremendous loyalty
that does not
waiver.

name: People Running About
description:
Although they always
suffer in silence,
they swear an oath
to inevitably
revolt.

name: Shapesnatch
description:
A bow tie with
horrible power, it
attacks an opponent
by controlling
others.

name: United Resistance
description:
The people that
gather to swear to
fight their
oppressors. A
revolution is
coming.

name: Boneheimer
description:
This monster wanders
the seas, sucking
dry any creatures it
may encounter.

name: Y-Dragon Head
description:
A machine with a
dragon head that
fires from its
jaws. It can unite
with other machines.

name: Z-Metal Tank
description:
A heavy tank
armored in metal.
It can unite with
other machines.

name: V-Tiger Jet
description:
A jet shaped like a
tiger. It can unite
with other
machines.

name: W-Wing Catapult
description:
A winged catapult.
It can unite with
other machines.

name: Panther Warrior
description:
A warrior with the
power of a panther.
It attacks only by
tributing a monster.

name: Jinzo
description:
Traps cannot be
activated while this
cyborg is face up.
Trap effects on the
field are negated.

name: Cyber-Tech Alligator
description:
A cyborg alligator
with a metal jaw.

name: The Legendary Fisherman
description:
Warrior from Joey's
Legendary
Collection.

name: Sword Hunter
description:
Warrior from Joey's
Legendary
Collection.

name: Hayabusa Knight
description:
Warrior from Joey's
Legendary
Collection.

name: Mad Sword Beast
description:
Dinosaur from Joey's
Legendary
Collection.

name: Goblin Attack Force
description:
Warrior from Joey's
Legendary
Collection.

name: The Fiend Megacyber
description:
Warrior from Joey's
Legendary
Collection.

name: Gearfried the Iron Knight
description:
Warrior from Joey's
Legendary
Collection.

name: Marauding Captain
description:
Warrior from Joey's
Legendary
Collection.

name: Fiber Jar
description:
Plant from Joey's
Legendary
Collection.

name: Sasuke Samurai
description:
Warrior from Joey's
Legendary
Collection.

name: Neko Mane King
description:
Beast from Joey's
Legendary
Collection.

name: Little-Winguard
description:
Warrior from Joey's
Legendary
Collection.

name: Insect Queen
description:
Insect from Joey's
Legendary
Collection.

name: Red-Eyes Darkness Dragon
description:
A dragon of the red-
eyed line. Gains 300
ATK for each Dragon
on its owner's side.

name: Gilford the Legend
description:
A legendary warrior
of the Legendary
Collection.

name: Gilford the Lightning
description:
A lightning warrior.
Gains 300 ATK for
each Warrior on the
field.

name: Rocket Warrior
description:
After a battle it
fights in, its
opponent loses 500
ATK.

name: Dunames Dark Witch
description:
Even when all odds
are against this
brave fairy, she
will press onwards
in battle and never
retreat.

name: Flame Dancer
description:
This monster moves
while swinging its
burning rope.

name: Lightning Conger
description:
This massive eel
generates huge
charges of
electricity and
unleashes them as
thunderbolts.

name: Spherous Lady
description:
Many have been
deceived by the
beauty of this
vampire.

name: Zombyra the Dark
description:
A dark warrior with
a deadly sword arm,
but too reckless to
guard himself.

name: Maryokutai
description:
A mass of magic
energy that flows
like water and
drifts about the
battlefield.
